test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘PEDAGOGY’ is written as ‘QGGECLEX’ and ‘CLASSICS’ is written as ‘DNDWOFAR’. How will ‘TOGETHER’ be written in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is:​

‘PEDAGOGY’ is written as ‘QGGECLEX’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/327a3789f9ab738d50ea7dafab1c7fa69fd83337efc4eec20e60998c4e70a234.png] 

And,

‘CLASSICS’ is written as ‘DNDWOFAR’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe68f52ee08587376e5ecfb6e85920965eebb9dd82862b2e0fc330dc2ccabb12.png] 

Similarly,

‘TOGETHER’ will be written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a9cb3c044329de2d7e8874b5b8d15ea387e385300386db46e604ffdc09b3ed6.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
